title: SWF: SceneAndFrameLabelData tag (tag 86)
description: SWF v9+ uses tag 86 to store scene names and frame labels for ActionScript access. For Flash 8 SWF v8, this tag is optional but useful. Implement encodeSceneAndFrameLabelData in packages/swf/src/scenelabels.ts that encodes all scene names and frame labels. Emit it after FileAttributes in compile.ts. Body format: NumScenes (encoded U32), then for each scene: offset (U32) + name (null-terminated string); then NumFrameLabels (U32), then for each label: frameNum (U32) + label string. Add tests.
